'''Chestnuts''' are a type of [[tree]] found in dry areas of [[biome|temperate forests]]. Like the overwhelming majority of overland trees, chestnut [[carpenter|wood]] is brown and produces brown products. 

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] chestnuts for their ''spiny pods'', their ''smelly catkins'', their ''chestnuts'' and their ''autumn coloration''. So yes, you can have a dwarf who likes chestnuts for their chestnuts.
